answer_1.quote: We benchmark the quality and usability of our StorySparkQA on the QAG task, which is required to meet the needs of teachers to guide children to learn some real-work knowledge during practical interactive story reading.
answer_1.outputs: QA pairs and real-world knowledge triples

answer_2.quote: We utilize Rouge-L to evaluate the quality of concatenated QA pairs between the generated ones and two expert-annotated ground truths... and incorporate SBERT using Sentence Transformer for automated evaluation.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a human study with four education experts to compare expert-annotated QA pairs and those generated by fine-tuned T5-Large and GPT-4... Four experts evaluate each QA pair on the following four dimensions with a 5-point Likert scale...
answer_4.guideline: Four experts evaluate each QA pair on the following four dimensions with a 5-point Likert scale: 1. Grammar Correctness... 2. Answer Relevancy... 3. Contextual Consistency... 4. Children's Educational Appropriateness.
